purpose: Challenge whether BUB1B cross-modal agreement and everolimus associations survive broad shared-response removal; descriptive sensitivity, not causal adjustment.
source: frozen public LINCS2020 and v23 RNAi prepared inputs from v25
aggregation: equal arithmetic mean of all same-gene signatures per cell, preserving v25; no QC relabelling
projection: Rank-normalize each original signature mean across features; fit first 10 right singular vectors to vertically stacked RNAi and CRISPR rows from nonexcluded targets, after removal of pooled mean direction; then project all ranked rows off mean and first k vectors and unit normalize. No refitting after outcome.
controls: v25 unadjusted BUB1B and MTOR correlations/ranks reproduced
top 20 in each direction for both query genes
CPU double-precision subset compared against CUDA float32 <=2e-5
limitations: Post-hoc stress test chosen after knowing HT29 favorable result; not external validation.
Removing principal components can remove real biology; attenuation is not disproof or a causal confounding estimate.
No controls labelled benign, no empirical tail converted to p-value or FDR.
Same one-guide and failed-QC caveats persist even if stable.
No genotype-plus-drug experiments and no clinical exposure inference.
drug_identity: Reference-matching BRD-K13514097 only; keep all same-cell contexts and QC, dose/time separately; no model promotion.
